cases.sentence: Устрой против него осаду: сооруди укрепления, насыпь ___, расположи под ним лагеря и окружи его стенобитными орудиями.
cases.explain: «осадный вал» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

cases.sentence: Устрой против него осаду: сооруди укрепления, насыпь осадный вал, расположи под ним лагеря и окружи его ___.
cases.explain: «стенобитными орудиями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

cases.sentence: Возьми железный противень, поставь его ___ между собой и городом и повернись к нему лицом.
cases.explain: «железной стеной» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Take for yourself an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

cases.sentence: Ты же ляг на ___ и возложи на себя грех дома Израиля.
cases.explain: «левый бок» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

cases.sentence: Когда исполнишь это, ляг снова, но теперь на ___, и неси грех дома Иуды.
cases.explain: «правый бок» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

cases.sentence: Ешь пищу, как ячменные лепешки; пеки их на глазах у людей на ___, — 13 сказал Господь.
cases.explain: «человеческом кале» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

cases.sentence: — Хорошо, — сказал Он, — Я позволяю тебе печь твой хлеб на коровьем навозе, вместо ___.
cases.explain: «человеческого кала» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
